description.zh:
告警对象搜索 json格式 包含字段如下 ：

rule_status	NUMBER	否	1：打开 0:闭合		
启停状态

alarm_status	NUMBER	否	0		
告警状态

only_me	BOOLEAN	否	true, false		
只看我

current_page	NUMBER	否	1		
当前页

page_size	NUMBER	否	3		
页面尺寸

workspace_name	STRING	是	工作区名		
工作区名

rule_id	NUMBER	否			
告警规则id

rule_unique_identity	STRING	否	1234_asdf		
告警唯一标识

category	STRING	是	"自定义"、"pql"		
标识符 区分规则是自定义规则还是pql规则

ref_datasource_type	STRING	否	datasource
		
filter_user_group	NUMBER	否	1		
根据用户组过滤

filter_webhook	NUMBER	否	1		
根据webhook过滤

filter_ding_robot	NUMBER	否	1		
钉钉机器人过滤
description.en:
Alarm object search in JSON format. The following fields are included:

rule_status	NUMBER	No	1: enabled, 0: disabled		
Rule status

alarm_status	NUMBER	No	0		
Alert Status

only_me	BOOLEAN	No	true, false		
View only my items

current_page	NUMBER	No	1		
Current page

page_size	NUMBER	No	3		
Page size

workspace_name	STRING	Yes	Workspace name		
Workspace name

rule_id	NUMBER	No			
Alert rule ID

rule_unique_identity	STRING	No	1234_asdf		
UUID of the alert rule

category	STRING	Yes	"Custom", "pql"		
Identifier indicating whether the rule is a Custom rule or a PQL rule

ref_datasource_type	STRING	No	datasource		
filter_user_group	NUMBER	No	1		
Filter by group

filter_webhook	NUMBER	No	1		
Filter by webhook

filter_ding_robot	NUMBER	No	1		
Filter by DingTalk Robot

description.zh: 告警规则名称模糊搜索
description.en: Fuzzy search by alert rule name
Rule status: 1 for enabled, 0 for disabled
